امتزجوا (form VIII)
# اِمْتَزَجُوا (imtazajū) /im.ta.za.d͡ʒuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِمْتَزَجَ (imtazaja)
# اُمْتُزِجُوا (umtuzijū) /um.tu.zi.d͡ʒuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِمْتَزَجَ (imtazaja)
# اِمْتَزِجُوا (imtazijū) /im.ta.zi.d͡ʒuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِمْتَزَجَ (imtazaja)
